title: Dusk Lord Online
summary: A free medieval fantasy MMORPG in one persistent shared world. Found a guild and put your people to work, trade in a market that turns with the seasons, delve into generated dungeons, and march your army across the map to besiege rival guild halls.
about:
Dusk Lord Online is a medieval fantasy MMORPG set in one persistent world that every player shares. Choose a class, ride out of one of four kingdoms and make your name. Delve into dungeons, hunt monsters, trade across borders, join a guild, make friends, make enemies, fight wars, and most importantly have fun.

Eight Classes, Forty-Eight Spells
Play as an Arcanist, Dawnpriest, Hexcaller, Stormcaller, Wildwarden, Oathsworn, Ironclad or Berserker. Each class has six ranks of spells. Spells carry elements such as fire, ice, holy and dark, and they react with one another. You commit to one class; however, you can change at any time.

Into the Depths
Descend through the city sewers and the mountain caverns. Walk the mazes of the spire, or take the Abyss, whose five floors collapse behind you. Fight a bestiary of monsters, and band together against four world bosses: Gorehide, Rimewrought, the Drowned Court and Ashmaw. Between adventures, cast a line or hunt for treasure.

A Guild and a Hall of Your Own
Found a guild for 100 gold and claim a stone hall with a shared chest. Your members' earnings feed a treasury, caravans led by pack elephants bring in sales, and your members draw a wage from the hall.

A World on a Clock
One real hour is one game day. Dawn, dusk, moon phases, rain, storms, snow and auroras change how the world plays, and each season lasts 91 real days.

An Economy You Can Work
Prices depend on stock and on what each kingdom wants. Sell too much and the price falls. Buy where goods are cheap and sell where they are dear. Use the global auction house, keep your gold in a bank vault, and take out a loan to grow faster.

Fight Your Way
PvP is open-world outside the cities, campfires and dungeons. For a fair fight, enter the ranked arena in 1v1, 2v2 or 3v3.

Key Features

• 
One shared, persistent world broken into shards that you can switch between seamlessly
• 
Guild halls with a shared chest, caravans and member wages
• 
A living, time-driven economy with banking, loans and an auction house
• 
Open-world PvP, ranked arenas, dungeons, mazes, caverns, sewers and the collapsing Abyss
• 
Generated dungeons, 48 spells across 8 classes, a bestiary of foes, fishing and treasure hunting
• 
Mining, woodcutting, cooking, smithing and enchanting
• 
Talent trees, quests, dailies and weeklies, achievements and a 30-day login bonus
• 
Mounts, including a flying griffin, and mount breeding
• 
Parties, mail, forum, friends and ladders
• 
A day/night cycle, weather and seasons that shape play
• 
Server-authoritative movement, combat and prices, so the world stays fair
• 
A very small download: EVERY mesh, texture and font is generated at runtime, so the whole game is about 18 MB. No need to bloat your PC.
• 
Windows 64-bit, with Steam Deck support waiting for approval
